The user specifically says "in the New York Stock Exchange". Apple Inc. is listed on NASDAQ, not NYSE. Google LLC (Alphabet) is also listed on NASDAQ. Microsoft Corporation is listed on NASDAQ as well. So none of these are listed on NYSE. The user might be mistaken. We should clarify that none of these companies are listed on NYSE.
